title: Start
body:
Lupe finds out his friends hung out without inviting him.
He feels hurt but doesn’t know how to react.
What should Lupe do?
[[ A. Lupe posts something passive-aggressive online. |option13]]
[[ B. Lupe distances himself without explanation. |option14]]
[[ C. Lupe calmly talks to his friends about how he feels. |option15]]
